title: Default OIDC token stubs hard-code us-east-1 even for region-faithful clients
reasoning: The stub supports region-faithful registration, but the default token path ignores the input client and always returns a StoredSSOToken with region "us-east-1". Tests that sign in or refresh outside us-east-1 can therefore persist or act on a token whose region no longer matches the client/session being exercised, masking bugs in later region-based refresh, sign-out, or portal routing paths.
reproduction: Create StubOIDCRequesting(registerRegion: "us-east-2") and allow createToken to use its default canned result; the returned StoredSSOToken.region is still "us-east-1".
recommendation: Make the canned token path region-aware. Either add a region parameter to makeDefaultSSOToken and initialize nextCreateTokenResult/nextRefreshResult from registerRegion, or have createToken/refreshToken synthesize/override the returned token region from the supplied StoredOIDCClient unless a test explicitly opts into a mismatched token.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The current stubs expose call counts and provider region requests, but they do not assert that the default token region matches the registered client region for non-us-east-1 sessions.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a stub-focused test that constructs StubOIDCRequesting(registerRegion: "us-east-2"), calls createToken with the registered client, and expects the returned StoredSSOToken.region to be "us-east-2".
minimumFixScope: Packages/QuorraCore/Tests/IAMIdentityCenterTests/Stubs/StubOIDCRequesting.swift and any tests that currently rely on makeDefaultSSOToken() implicitly using us-east-1.
